hypotheses.statement: Failed auctions may improve when daily trend aligns and at least 2R of objective-level room remains after accounting for daily ATR consumption.
hypotheses.overlap_notes: Conditions existing candidates; creates no new trigger.

hypotheses.statement: Timestamp-valid quote pressure and absorption may distinguish genuine rejection from continued level failure.
hypotheses.overlap_notes: Complements candle context; venue liquidity is only a proxy.

hypotheses.statement: Repeated independent tests may change failed-auction quality relative to first touches.
hypotheses.overlap_notes: Uses existing metadata and requires no new provider calls.

hypotheses.statement: M1 watch followed by M5 confirmation improves failed-auction timing over M15 confirmation.
hypotheses.overlap_notes: Forward review showed negative average R and excessive false reversals.

hypotheses.statement: M1 may add entry-timing value after a higher-timeframe setup is independently validated.
hypotheses.overlap_notes: Not a standalone trigger and too noisy for current activation.

hypotheses.statement: A local model may summarize continuous near-level state without paid provider calls.
hypotheses.overlap_notes: Infrastructure cannot create edge and must not gain order authority.

hypotheses.statement: A locked calibrator may improve confidence interpretation after the stationary baseline is sufficiently large.
hypotheses.overlap_notes: Cannot alter gates or policy automatically.

hypotheses.statement: A predeclared monthly G10 cross-sectional currency excess-return momentum portfolio may retain positive net returns after pair-specific transaction costs in chronological out-of-sample and untouched dated confirmation windows.
hypotheses.overlap_notes: Cross-sectional multi-currency ranking is structurally distinct from the existing EUR/USD failed-auction context campaigns.

hypotheses.statement: Currencies with the largest five-year real bilateral depreciation may outperform the most appreciated G10 currencies over the next month after locked turnover costs.
hypotheses.overlap_notes: Real-exchange-rate mean reversion is distinct from price momentum and the EUR failed-auction campaigns.

hypotheses.statement: Material three-month changes in inflation-adjusted foreign-versus-US policy stance may continue in next-month spot when contemporaneous currency movement confirms the shift.
hypotheses.overlap_notes: Monetary-policy divergence is economically distinct from price-only momentum, value, and EUR failed-auction campaigns.

hypotheses.statement: Currencies with the strongest five-year industrial-production growth may outperform those with the weakest growth over the next month.
hypotheses.overlap_notes: Economic-activity momentum is distinct from price momentum, real-exchange-rate value, policy stance, and EUR failed-auction campaigns.

hypotheses.statement: Currencies of economies with stronger recursively estimated output gaps may appreciate against currencies of weaker economies over the next month.
hypotheses.overlap_notes: Cyclical output residuals are distinct from five-year economic momentum, value, policy stance, and EUR failed-auction campaigns.

hypotheses.statement: Independent Japanese FX-intervention episodes may produce policy-aligned short-horizon USD/JPY movement that warrants later observable-proxy research.
hypotheses.overlap_notes: Official intervention is a policy-event mechanism distinct from price-pattern, carry, value, and business-cycle campaigns.

hypotheses.statement: A completed close accepting beyond a prior-day or completed-session level followed by a retest that holds beyond the level may have positive net expectancy after spread.
hypotheses.overlap_notes: Continuation mechanism distinct from failed-auction reversals.

hypotheses.statement: A sweep outside a completed 30-minute opening range followed by a close back inside may have positive net expectancy after spread.
hypotheses.overlap_notes: Time-anchored reversal mechanism kept separate from generic objective-level failed auctions.

hypotheses.statement: Session VWAP reclaim and one-ATR stretch reversion may each have positive net expectancy when evaluated as separate fixed setups.
hypotheses.overlap_notes: Intraday volume-location mechanism distinct from horizontal-level and HTF trend triggers.

hypotheses.statement: An M15 pullback to EMA20 that rejects in the direction of agreeing completed H1 and H4 trends may have positive net expectancy after spread.
hypotheses.overlap_notes: Trend continuation mechanism; portfolio overlap with existing HTF profiles must be measured before adoption.

hypotheses.statement: A sweep outside a completed 30-minute opening range followed by a close back inside may have positive net expectancy when session opens are defined in daylight-saving-aware local market time.
hypotheses.overlap_notes: Supersedes the fixed-UTC V1 ORB specification before it collected evidence.

hypotheses.statement: An AUD/USD sweep outside the daylight-saving-aware Sydney 08:00-08:30 opening range followed by a completed M15 close back inside may have positive net expectancy after observed spread.
hypotheses.overlap_notes: AUD/USD Asia-Pacific time-anchored reversal mechanism; researched independently from EUR/USD and not authorized for trading-agent or bot adoption.

hypotheses.statement: A large completed USD/CNH impulse during the Shanghai trading window may lead a lagging but subsequently confirming inverse AUD/USD move with positive net expectancy after observed costs.
hypotheses.overlap_notes: China-proxy intermarket information-flow mechanism, distinct from the six completed AUD/USD session-range, commodity-risk, rate-shock, cross-breadth, and RBA-event hypotheses.

hypotheses.statement: A sweep beyond a completed prior-week or prior-month high or low followed by a completed M15 directional close back through the level may have positive forward net expectancy after observed spread.
hypotheses.overlap_notes: Higher-timeframe objective-level failed auctions are evaluated separately from session-level failed auctions and opening-range reversals.

hypotheses.statement: A newly re-armed extreme in CFTC leveraged-money FX futures positioning may predict a contrarian 20-day spot move after publication-safe entry and costs.
hypotheses.overlap_notes: Official positioning mechanism distinct from price-pattern and session-flow families; evaluated independently for each pair.

hypotheses.statement: On the first two or last two London weekdays of a month, a sufficiently large London-open-to-fix directional stretch followed by a completed post-fix reversal candle may have positive forward net expectancy after observed spread.
hypotheses.overlap_notes: Calendar-flow mechanism distinct from ORB, VWAP, horizontal objective-level, and HTF trend campaigns.

hypotheses.statement: The first daylight-saving-aware London 30-minute opening-range sweep and completed M15 close back inside each trading day may have positive forward net expectancy and outperform following the same failed breakout.
hypotheses.overlap_notes: Fresh confirmatory refinement of the broad DST-safe ORB reversal after that population failed its corrected non-overlapping review; no prior outcomes qualify.

hypotheses.statement: The first Tokyo-local 30-minute opening-range sweep and completed M15 close back inside each trading day may have positive forward net expectancy and outperform following the same failed breakout.
hypotheses.overlap_notes: Session-specific companion to London V3; Asia and London observations remain separate and cannot be pooled for qualification.

hypotheses.statement: Causally available CME FX futures volume, open interest, and settlement direction may improve selection of a fixed prior-day accepted-breakout/retest setup across EUR/USD, USD/JPY, and AUD/USD.
hypotheses.overlap_notes: Context-selection test on one fixed spot setup; it is not a new standalone futures-direction signal and pair-level results are descriptive only.

hypotheses.statement: An unusually high-volume, range-expanding CME FX futures bar may predict either immediate continuation when its close accepts the attempted direction or reversal when its close rejects the attempted direction.
hypotheses.overlap_notes: Futures-native event trigger rather than a filter on a spot setup; continuation and failed-auction reversal are separate confirmatory hypotheses.

hypotheses.statement: A weekly inverse-volatility G10 portfolio whose pair direction is supported by at least two of the prior 21-, 63-, and 126-common-day spot returns may have positive net spot expectancy after turnover costs.
hypotheses.overlap_notes: Time-series trend evaluates each pair against its own past and is distinct from the existing monthly G10 cross-sectional MOM(1,1) ranking campaign.

hypotheses.statement: A monthly long-or-cash portfolio across liquid equity, Treasury, gold, commodity, and dollar ETFs, selected by positive twelve-month trend and inverse-volatility sized, may deliver positive excess-cash returns with better risk-adjusted performance than locked controls.
hypotheses.overlap_notes: Cross-asset long-or-cash risk-premium research, distinct from the rejected seven-pair FX-only weekly time-series momentum ensemble.

hypotheses.statement: A one-month-delayed version of the locked cross-asset ETF trend target may retain positive excess-cash returns and risk-adjusted performance when evaluated as a new primary against independent distributions-adjusted prices and evidence not used to select it.
hypotheses.overlap_notes: Post-control lead from rejected V1; it carries no edge claim, cannot inherit V1 approval, and cannot use the V1 dated window as confirmatory evidence.

hypotheses.statement: A positive SPY return from the previous regular close through 10:00 New York time may predict a positive cost-adjusted long return from 15:30 through 15:55 on the same session.
hypotheses.overlap_notes: Intraday SPY timing mechanism distinct from the monthly cross-asset delayed-trend allocation; it shares SPY exposure but not holding horizon or signal construction.

hypotheses.statement: The single worst volatility-normalized five-session move across seven liquid cross-asset ETFs may rebound over the next three sessions strongly enough to produce positive net excess-BIL returns.
hypotheses.overlap_notes: Short-horizon cross-asset overshoot mechanism, distinct from the rejected SPY intraday timing rule and monthly ETF trend allocation.
